call_points.text: **Festive shift impact:** Management noted an advertising revenue impact of almost ₹40 Cr due to the 8-day shift of Navratra to Q3.
**Newsprint cost inflation:** Per tonne cost increased by about 21% to ₹57,000 compared to ₹47,000 last year.
Newsprint prices rose to ₹49,000/ton in Q4 and are guided to increase 6% to 8% in Q1FY27.
Excluding the election impact, print advertising revenue grew 6.3% YoY in FY26.
The Board is evaluating more tax-efficient avenues to deploy cash rather than a standard dividend payout.
Radio launched 7 new stations expanding to 37 cities, with all 7 turning EBITDA positive within 3 months.

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: The company filed a Letters Patent Appeal. (LPA) against the order of Ld. Single Judge dtd. 31.07.2024 passed in contempt proceedings, before the Division Bench of Hon'ble Madras High Court. The LPA came up for hearing on 29.08.2024 wherein the court granted interim stay on the operation of order of Ld. Single Judge and directed the matter be listed for hearing. Interim stay was further extended on 05.09.2024 till next date of hearing. Next date of hearing before Division Bench is awaited. No new date of listing has provided so far as an appeal related to a similar matter is pending in Supreme Court, outcome of which may result in some movement in this case. The Interim stay continues. The Supreme Court hearing was scheduled for 11.08.2025 but the matter could not reach the board and next date was assigned. Now the court has listed the matter on 09.10.2025 for final arguments.

entities.type: wholly owned subsidiary of DB Infomedia Private Limited

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Media, Entertainment & Publication > Media > Print Media

operating_notes.text: Digital Monthly Active Users (MAUs) reached ~20 million as of March 2026.
Newsprint prices saw increases due to supply disruptions and forex movements, expected to be temporary for a couple of quarters.
Q4FY26 newsprint mix stood at 77% domestic and 23% imported.
Average newsprint rate was ₹49,000 per ton in Q4FY26 vs ₹48,000 per ton in FY26, with an expected 6-8% increase in Q1FY27.
Combined monthly active users of Dainik Bhaskar and Divya Bhaskar apps reached ~18 million as of August 2026.
Newsprint cost increased to approximately ₹57,000 per tonne in Q2 FY27.

timeline.summary: Sudhir Agarwal, as promoter of D.B.Corp Limited, declared no encumbrance on shares held during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹576.39 Cr (+5.2% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹63.98 Cr (+26.9% YoY).
D.B.Corp Limited uploaded the audio recording of its May 11, 2026, conference call on financials for Q4FY26 and FY26 at 4:30 PM (IST) via its website.
DB Corp released its Q4FY26 earnings call transcript, projecting strong single-digit advertising growth in FY27 alongside a 6-8% Q1 newsprint price increase.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹580.81 Cr (-5.5% YoY), net profit ₹68.62 Cr (-26.6% YoY).
Audio recording of the Conference Call held on October 16, 2026 uploaded on the company website.
DB Corp reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹614 Cr and PAT of ₹69 Cr, impacted by a festive season shift and higher newsprint costs.
